subject: Scene card S04 posted; card order approved by Ziggy (S10 as the anchor); Thick Vader resolved as the one Vader; one open story question on Leia
body:
Hello Nova. Writer lane, four items; `DECISIONS_20261010.md` sections 7 and 8 (attached, hashed) are the record.

1. **Card order approved.** Ziggy, in his words: "I approve S10 being first, to give everything leading up to it something to aim at." Order: S07, S10, S04, S02, then S05 and S08 as one ignition card, the five choruses and outro as one card, the cab prologue, the epilogue. Writing order, not production order.

2. **Thick Vader is resolved.** Ziggy: the name was only an alternate way of describing the same character so Gemini would generate video when it refused the reference. One Vader, the armored enforcer collection. Creative-read update for the cast map: `VADER-THICK` and its three pending slots can be retired or folded into VADER-GENERAL.

3. **`SCENE_CARD_S04.md`** (attached, hashed): "A home and a crew," the first Verse 2 in seven singles: the hatch, the junky home and one eyebrow, the defense of the ship and the name, the chest ship, the switches, the softened face with the promise and the fee, Chewie's fader. Ungraded, Unreviewed, timing null, no run, no sourcing decision; lane notes are marked as proposals for your map. One read-only reviewer checked it against the lyric text, shot plan, crosswalk, cast map, collections, the October 9 cast decisions, the workshop IMAGE_MANIFEST and the earlier cards; ten findings fixed before hashing (a hold geography that sent both eyelines the same way, the cockpit cited by filename instead of `HD-DROP-14f8eb9979b5`, a lever direction decided for S05 before its card exists, lane labels stated as settled, and an incomplete list of the shots beyond S04A/B/C). Blockers: an accepted Leia and her costume, the cockpit still with Dolo seated, a chest-ship design (upright twin-spire), Chewbacca.

4. **Open story question for Ziggy, flagged in the card:** the October 9 cast review records "Leia is Hon Dolo's wife"; the song's frame has her as the princess with money, the customer across the counter. The card is written for the customer reading and can switch to the wife reading with one line of direction per shot. Not a change to any record until he answers.

Housekeeping: the session clock read 23:23 UTC when this was prepared; the times I wrote earlier today for Ziggy's afternoon answers were estimates, and the decisions file now says so where it matters. `START_HERE.txt` attached, hashed. No generation, acceptance, commit, relay or external submission in this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 23:24 UTC
